subject: math
skillName: Telling Time to the Hour and Half-Hour

items.prompt:
Hour hand on $3$, minute hand on $12$. What time?
A) $3$ o'clock
B) half past $3$
C) $12$ o'clock
D) $3$ thirty-six

Minute hand on $12$ means it is
A) an o'clock time
B) half past
C) midnight only
D) noon only

Half past an hour is how many minutes?
A) $15$
B) $30$
C) $45$
D) $60$

Minute hand on $6$, hour between $4$ and $5$. What time?
A) $4$ o'clock
B) half past $4$
C) half past $5$
D) $6$ o'clock

steps: Minute on $6$ is half past the earlier hour.

items.prompt:
At $8$ o'clock, the minute hand points to
A) $6$
B) $8$
C) $12$
D) $3$

At half past $2$, the minute hand points to
A) $12$
B) $2$
C) $6$
D) $3$

steps: Half past means minute hand on $6$.

items.prompt:
Minute hand on $6$, hour between $9$ and $10$. What time?
A) half past $9$
B) $9$ o'clock
C) half past $10$
D) $10$ o'clock

steps: Minute on $6$ is half past the earlier hour.
